entries.title: Psalms 81:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph.>> Sing ye joyously unto God our strength, shout aloud unto the God of Jacob;

entries.title: Psalms 81:2
segments: Raise a song, and sound the tambour, the pleasant harp with the lute.

entries.title: Psalms 81:3
segments: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, at the set time, on our feast day:

entries.title: Psalms 81:4
segments: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob;

entries.title: Psalms 81:5
segments: He ordained it in Joseph [for] a testimony, when he went forth over the land of Egypt, [where] I heard a language that I knew not.

entries.title: Psalms 81:6
segments: I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.

entries.title: Psalms 81:7
segments: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 81:8
segments: ¶Hear, my people, and I will testify unto thee; O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!

entries.title: Psalms 81:9
segments: There shall no strange *god be in thee, neither shalt thou worship any foreign *god.

entries.title: Psalms 81:10
segments: I am Jehovah thy God, that brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

entries.title: Psalms 81:11
segments: But my people hearkened not to my voice, and Israel would none of me.

entries.title: Psalms 81:12
segments: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' stubbornness: they walked after their own counsels.

entries.title: Psalms 81:13
segments: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, that Israel had walked in my ways!

entries.title: Psalms 81:14
segments: I would soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

entries.title: Psalms 81:15
segments: The haters of Jehovah would have come cringing unto him; but their time would have been for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 81:16
segments: And he would have fed them with the finest of wheat; yea, with honey out of the rock would I have satisfied thee.
